name: 55379 · Shakopee, MN
findings: ZIP 55379 (Shakopee) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 55379 (Shakopee) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
